name: search_cocktail_by_name
description: Look up full cocktail recipes by name. Use when the guest names a specific drink (e.g. "how do I make a margarita?" or "what's in a negroni?"). Returns matching cocktails with ingredients, measures, glass, and instructions.

name.description: The cocktail name to search for, e.g. "margarita" or "old fashioned".
